verdict.rationale: Crossmint's Agent Cards product directly delivers this story: order intents give agents a fixed allowance with amount, description, and expiration, enforced by Visa/Mastercard network rails, with the agent never seeing the real card number, and merchant locking restricts the credential to a single merchant for its lifetime. Documentation details revocability, expiry-based deactivation, and eligibility scoping. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
